requirements.location: Complete reports/current.md lines 1-373; operating/cash roles 11-59, longitudinal and regional evidence 61-135, two warehouse models 137-210, sensitivity/break-even/capacity 212-266, working capital/network/store alternatives 268-311, operating constraints 313-333 and conditional decisions 335-364
requirements.basis: The manuscript supplies the requested complete comparison rather than relying on headings. It defines self-owned fresh warehouses, independent social warehouses, franchise/cooperation and store fulfillment with distinct ownership, inventory, traffic, settlement and fixed-cost responsibilities. A balanced single-order funds example separates platform contribution from merchant contribution and avoids adding the same spending twice. The historical cases include exit, regional withdrawal, underperforming warehouses and accounting effects; the regional table distinguishes mature East China, southern cities, Beijing submarkets and Chengdu/Chongqing without inferring local warehouse density from national or municipal averages. Demand is connected to households, frequency, share, road/time radius, competition, peak load, stock availability and loss. The two explicit monthly models separate net merchandise revenue, procurement margin, loss, packing/incremental picking, delivery, fees, paid traffic, rent/labor/energy/depreciation, upstream/head-office allocation, inventory funding and subsidies. Results distinguish contribution, warehouse profit, allocated operating result and company net profit; inventory opportunity cost and cash recovery are separately explained. Sensitivities include order density, basket value, margin, waste, delivery, traffic and subsidy withdrawal, followed by stepped-cost break-even, peak-hour labor/rider constraints, six-month ramp cash needs and neighbor-warehouse cannibalization. Store fulfillment is treated as a distinct shared-resource alternative. Food safety, labor and service quality enter the operating conditions, and the final mature-area/new-entry decisions derive from these mechanisms. Selected original sources substantiate the consequential discontinuation-accounting caveat and Beijing operator cases rather than turning them into an audited census. Original R_TASK and frozen/current report identity were verified. No material requested answer or condition is missing within this requirements perspective; no new arithmetic run is needed to establish this coverage.

domain.basis:
完整审读373行当前正文、任务和有效要求，按即时零售履约、会计与单仓经济的领域职责核查。四类模式的持货、定价、库存风险、平台收费与配送责任没有混为一体；50元示例的商家6元、平台0元与链外44元成本对得上，商品券和额外激励分开，内部平台收入未再算终端消费额。叮咚2025 20-F的年度收入/GMV、成本及费用原始段落支持2023–2025表；综合履约费含仓内/区域作业、租赁和物流，不能当纯骑手费用，正文已避免重复加仓租人工。2026Q2原公告明确国内业务终止经营列报、仍实际运营、停折旧摊销对净利润影响1.991亿元；0.726亿元仅为单项机械隔离，未冒充正式可比净利润。2月协议、8月待审批及10月27日发行文件受交割条件约束的状态均保持。每日优鲜原20-F金额、2022年7月业务关闭及20-F/A未更新财报的范围相符；退出样本没有被作为所有仓型必败的证明。永辉原PDF第5、8–9页支持线上100.9亿元、56.6/44.3亿元及门店/全仓混合分母，不可除349当纯店生产率。
实际核对深圳2024采访、广佛原采访、北京2026采访和成都重庆退出公告。正文将部分成本后20%余额、峰期/工作日日单、15:30订单、招商铺货报价、60%货品滞销分别限定，没有变成审计净利率、全天均值或库存金额损失。上海/深圳统计原文只作背景；商圈家庭×活跃率×频次×份额的405/140/697日单需求例及52.3%份额均标注假设，不由城市总人口外推仓数。
读取完整warehouse-model.py与既有全部scenario输入/结果、网络、平台桥、现金ramp及financial-bridges代码和结果，未执行。9.22/6元贡献、阶梯固定费用、上游分摊、采购损耗分离及29.82/12.4605万元库存的分母一致。697/334/400等整数最小盈亏平衡在各自成本档位和容量内求解，无解情景未被无限线性摊薄；跨档暂时重新亏损的限制明示。单项敏感性与联合促销、扩半径场景保留价格/毛利/配送/投流联动，1080单促销分摊后-77332.4元及扩半径-23192元与代码相符。峰时6/2名拣货员、32/24名共享并发骑手及扩半径51名的计算符合有效产能假设，正文没有当成全天编制或固定专属骑手人数，社会化81对80单/小时的缺乏缓冲也明确揭示。
现金桥加回折旧并扣存货增量，初始资本/押金与存货未双计；社会化28个月只是在无税、无追加资本等条件下回收全部初始现金的静态例，不是保证回本。六个月1048726元资金缺口未称全生命周期峰值；库存机会成本另列不重复扣。邻仓500单中300分流，网络净增200而月结果恶化90480元的关系正确，门店增量与完整共享成本回答不同决策。市场监管总局124号第2/10/12/18/22–25条及人社原指引2–14条核对后，正文食品责任、温控委托、三年交易记录、六个月核验和劳动关系适用边界一致。条件化经营建议与上述需求、质量、库存和现金约束相容，未发现需要修订的领域缺陷。
